title: Latin

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Students in good academic standing may declare this major at any time.

sections.credentialOverview:
Credential Overview

The B.A. in Latin allows students to develop advanced expertise in the Latin language and the literature and culture of ancient Rome.
sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

52-58 credits

• Either LATIN 101, LATIN 102, LATIN 103; or LATIN 300, LATIN 301 (10-15 credits)

• LATIN 305, LATIN 306, LATIN 307

• 15 credits of 400-level LATIN courses

• 10 credits from approved classics in English, classical art and archaeology, ancient history, the history of ancient philosophy, and the history of ancient science. See adviser for approved list.

• CLAS 495 (2-3 credits)
